title: Magic: The Gathering is getting a Netflix animated series. For real this time.
summary: "It's really happening. I promise. For real." Those are the first words from Roy Graham, Head of Story at Magic: The Gathering, in a video posted yesterday announcing Planeswalker, the animated series heading to Netflix in 2027. An animated Magic: The Gathering series was first teased back in 2019 with Joe and Anthony Russo at […]
llm_summary: Roy Graham, Head of Story at Wizards of the Coast, confirmed that a new animated series titled **“Planeswalker”**—based on the Magic: The Gathering universe—is officially in production for Netflix, with a slated release in 2027. After an early teaser in 2019 involving the Russo brothers, the project now has a confirmed creative lead and a clear timeline, marking the first fully realized TV adaptation of the popular trading‑card franchise.
